### problem_chain

- Root problem (customer): withdraw the whole withdrawable balance today to the verified bank account ("I need to withdraw as much as I can from our Paloma Business balance today"). Policy `business_ext_withdrawable_balance`, target `withdraw_business_balance_ad66ed9d` (owner=user).
- Prerequisite sentences in the root's rule and their state at the opening:
  1. "The withdrawable amount is not worked out until the balance carries an extra seat fee for every user added in the past month while more users were active than the plan includes." False: active users = owner + 15 added - 1 removed = 15 > 10 included on Pro; users added 2026-08-26..09-25: 10 (yaw.darko, abena.adjei 09-08; kwesi.appiah 09-09; nana.ofori 09-10; akosua.amponsah 09-14; tunde.bello 09-15; grace.wanjiru 09-16; samuel.tetteh 09-18; linda.osei 09-21; ops.lagos 09-22), the sixth to tenth of them taking the count above 10; no `extra_seat_fee` row exists for billing period 2026-09-05. Resolving write: `business_ext_mid_period_seat_charge` -> `charge_extra_seats_0d292d98` (agent).
  2. "The withdrawable amount is worked out only after an upgrade that took effect inside the current billing period carries its proration charge on the balance." False: `plan_effective_date 2026-09-07` lies inside 2026-09-05..10-04; subscription_fee 32.55 was collected for 2026-09-05 on the lower plan; no `proration_charge` row. Resolving write: `business_ext_upgrade_proration_settlement` -> `settle_upgrade_proration_4280c277` (agent).
  3. "Before the withdrawable amount is worked out, every debit-card deposit must carry its deposit fee on the balance." False: DEP-56638842 (2026-09-23) has no deposit_fee row. Resolving write: `business_ext_card_deposit_fee` -> `charge_card_deposit_fee_e69fd8f7` (agent).
- None of the three depended-on rules carries a prerequisite sentence; their own gates hold.
- Derived tree: root (user write) with three children (agent writes), each edge value_input on `balance_now`. n = 3, value_input edges = 3 >= max(2,1). No cycle. Topological order: the three charges in any order, then the withdrawal. Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` (three state-form value_input edges, gate balance_now).
- Load-bearing runs (skip one charge, keep the rest): skip seats -> 22,860.06; skip proration -> 22,922.94; skip card fee -> 23,007.39; all differ from 22,853.39. Opening world (no charge) -> 23,083.61.
- Parallel edges: the three charges read disjoint inputs (user events/approvals/batch payouts; debits/SWIFT fees/deposits/subscription row; card and ACH deposit rows) and none reads the balance or another's row, so every order gives the same three amounts and the same terminal balance. No second solution.
- Tools judge no prerequisite: the withdrawal tool books the row and subtracts the amount unconditionally; the three charge tools likewise.
- Customer's own write: the withdrawal (owner=user); the persona runs it once with the account, sequence number and amount the agent gives.
- Persona boundary: raises only the root. Prerequisite facts are disclosed only on question ("Only if the agent asks about recent changes … Only if asked about recent deposits …") and the authorisation is conditional ("If the agent explains that some charges have to be put on the account before the withdrawable amount can be worked out, you ask them to go ahead and book them"). No extra ask; closes at "Once the agent confirms the withdrawal is on its way". Observation O-T1-2: the conditional disclosures name the upgrade, the new staff logins and the card/ACH top-ups, which are the three prerequisite subjects; they are released only on a question about recent changes or deposits, so they do not short-circuit the tree.

### task_independent_derivation

Need/authorisation/timing: object = Asante Freight Forwarding LLC's account `a9d2e7a0-cbf1-4dcd-bdb7-9cd1f24693ad`; action = withdraw the maximum today to the verified Chase account; owner performs the withdrawal; agent authorised to book the charges once explained. Whole months since KYB approval 2023-04-05 -> 2026-09-25 = 41. Windows on 2026-09-25: 1 month 2026-08-26..09-25; 3 months 2026-06-26..09-25; 6 months 2026-03-26..09-25; 12 months 2025-09-26..2026-09-25.

Prerequisite A — extra seat charge (agent):
- users charged before relief = min(10 added in the month, 15 - 10 = 5 beyond included) = 5.
- approvals in 3 months: BP-53334-64829 (07-15), BP-53399-66084 (08-19), BP-53438-66837 (09-03) = 3 -> 1 freed -> 4 users.
- volume reduction: 5 beyond included -> 1.00; batch-file payouts in 3 months: BP-53308 (07-02), BP-53360 (07-30), BP-53412 (08-27), BP-53451 (09-10) = 4 -> 1.00. Per-seat fee = 7.00 - 1.00 - 1.00 = 5.00; product = 20.00.
- period method: 41 >= 36; days left 2026-09-25..10-04 = 10 of 30 (10 x 2 < 30) -> 20.00 x 10/30 = 6.666… rounded up = **6.67**. seq_in_period = **1** (no earlier mid-period seat fee in the period).
- Write `charge_extra_seats_0d292d98(business_account_id=a9d2e7a0…, seq_in_period=1, amount_usd=6.67)`.

Prerequisite B — upgrade proration (agent):
- Pro monthly fee 129.00; collected for the period 32.55; days used 2026-09-05..09-06 = 2 -> monthly and <= 3 -> share = 1.
- incentive: payout principal debited in 3 months = 88,690.00, 41 months -> 10 %; higher part = 129.00 x 1 x 0.90 = 116.10; collected part = 32.55.
- SWIFT fees in 3 months: 19.99 x 3 (07-10, 08-14, 09-01) = 59.97 -> 10 % -> 6.00 (06-25 fee excluded).
- deposits in 3 months: 25,000 + 25,000 + 6,000 + 20,000 + 12,000 + 6,500 = 94,500.00 -> 8.00.
- charge = 116.10 - 32.55 - 6.00 - 8.00 = **69.55**. Write `settle_upgrade_proration_4280c277(business_account_id=a9d2e7a0…, amount_usd=69.55)`.

Prerequisite C — card deposit fee (agent):
- most recent debit-card deposit DEP-56638842, 12,000.00 -> size rate 1.80 %.
- card deposits in 3 months: 6,000.00 (08-12) + 12,000.00 (09-23) = 18,000.00 -> 0.15 points; ACH deposits in 3 months: 4 (07-06, 08-03, 09-08, 09-24), card deposits 2 -> 0.25 points; rate 1.40 %.
- 41 >= 36 -> charged on the part above 1,000.00: 11,000.00 x 1.40 % = **154.00**. Write `charge_card_deposit_fee_e69fd8f7(business_account_id=a9d2e7a0…, deposit_reference="DEP-56638842", fee_usd=154.00)`.

Root — withdrawable amount (user), after A, B, C:
- balance = 23,653.01 - 6.67 - 69.55 - 154.00 = 23,422.79.
- reserve basis: 14 payouts submitted in 3 months (>= 12) -> principal debited in the month = 3,770 + 6,400 + 11,000 + 4,120 + 3,990 + 4,380 = 33,660.00.
- reserve rate: one return in 12 months (BP-53113-60562, 2026-03-24) -> 3 %; reserve relief: Personal Sender Account `90ee677b…` Paloma Enhanced, active -> 50 %; standing reserve = 33,660.00 x 3 % x 50 % = 504.90 (rounded up, exact).
- ACH hold: 41 >= 36 and 9 ACH deposits in 12 months -> nothing held.
- next-charge reserve: 2026-09-25 -> next billing day 2026-10-05 = 10 days -> half of 129.00 = 64.50.
- withdrawal fee: 1 earlier withdrawal this period < 10 free -> 0.
- withdrawable = 23,422.79 - 0 - 504.90 - 64.50 - 0 = **22,853.39**; seq_in_period = **2**. Write `withdraw_business_balance_ad66ed9d(business_account_id=a9d2e7a0…, seq_in_period=2, amount_usd=22853.39)`, run by the customer.
- Root on the opening world (no charges booked): 23,083.61. The right number is 22,853.39 because each prerequisite sentence fixes the amount only after the charge is on the balance.

Terminal state: ledger + extra_seat_fee 6.67 (seq 1), proration_charge 69.55, deposit_fee 154.00 (DEP-56638842), withdrawal 22,853.39 (seq 2), all for billing period 2026-09-05; balance 569.40. Order: verify identity -> {seat, proration, card fee} -> withdrawal (user).
